steps.row: A v0.1.0 S1, UI configure, Hub
D rollback, UI remove, final S1

scope: installed relocatable packages 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 under a versioned ROOT; Core under hidden-source bwrap; packaged Qt UI offscreen under its own bwrap (no repo, no uv, no network); virtual PCM/TTS S1; Hub approve/stage/install/remove; restart; update; rollback. No LLM, no network, no devices.
deviations: Wake selection is applied LAST in the configure step: a wake change puts the Core in restart_required, which disables Hub approve/install (by design). Contract order adjusted.
UI state trace by live polling sampled capturing/idle/speaking; transcribing/executing are derived from the Core event log, and the evidence marks which source each state came from.
limitations: Wake is replay only (no live microphone path); S1 audio is virtual PCM/TTS. Physical audio, CPAL/PipeWire/AEC/hotplug/barge-in, real KDE/Wayland and Flatpak/portal are NOT validated.
Packaged binary differs from target/release by design (same commit, remapped paths); regressions ran on target/release, package gates on the packaged binary.
No signing, update channel, autostart or UI for package update; power loss during update needs manual repair.
Publisher unauthenticated; plugin runtime disabled (S3). No LLM/Model Manager/Skills/Connections.
Physical/human validation remains consolidated after S5.
